name: 67-press-proccessor
features: Design tab draws a straight tuck end box dieline from width, depth, height, glue tab and tuck flap inputs in inches.
Solid lines show cuts and dashed lines show folds on the flat view.
Artwork panel generates new box art or revises current art through the Anthropic API using a key saved only in the browser.
Roll tab lays boxes out on the press web with side margin, gap, spit plate and calibration square, and RUN animates the roll feeding.
Print flat supports Letter, Tabloid and A4 sheet sizes, and Download SVG saves the dieline.
Save design and Load design keep designs between visits.
